title: Engineering two-dimensional carbon anodes for enhanced lithium battery performance
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01327E, Paper
Fuat Bilican, Fatih Ersan, Sevgi Ozdemir Kart
We systematically investigated the structural, electronic, and lithium storage properties of seven distinct 2D carbon allotropes (graphyne, dodecagonal graphene, kagome graphene, porous graphene, GY-5, haecklites (5–7), and T-graphene) using DFT.
